it.txt: Era vice-prefeita e tomou posse como prefeita em 31/03/2026, na Câmara Municipal, depois que Eduardo Braide renunciou ao cargo para disputar a eleição de 2026 para governador do Maranhão.
it.txt_en: She was vice mayor and was sworn in as mayor on March 31, 2026, at the City Council (the city's legislature), after Mayor Eduardo Braide resigned to run for governor of Maranhão state in the 2026 election.
